<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Trooper Guard''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍警備兵員</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">移動できない。攻撃時は、戦闘力＝0で、防御時は、戦闘力＝4となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Trooper-Guard-SWCA-100699.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦術や武器に長けたエリート兵士。デス・スター配属のタジス・ドゥアミンなどがその典型例で、重要拠点に配置されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Trooper Guard.

'''Card text:'''
Cannot move. Power is 0 when attacking and 4 when defending.

'''Lore:'''
Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. Tajis Durmin, assigned to the Death Star, is a typical example. They are stationed at key positions.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese and original English faces both specify power 0 when attacking and 4 when defending.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Trooper Guard]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
